positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: PHP, JS, MySQL, MSSQL, Progress / Openedge, PTI Fusion Pro development and administration

positions.title: Application Specialist
positions.description:
•	PHP, HTML, CSS and database development (MySQL and MSSQL) for the internal organization, and its clients.
•	Fully support the efi application offerings used within O’Neil Printing including Monarch MIS, iQuote, iQuote CRM, iPlan, and PrintFlow along with all reporting requirements (Crystal Reports, SQL queries, etc.).
•	Assist in the development and support of a data warehouse for the company
•	Assist with ad hoc technical support requirements
•	Provide technical support for information technology infrastructure including company servers, , individual workstations, telephone systems, LANs, WANs, Internet and intranet systems, and network segments
•	Perform other duties as assigned

positions.title: Certificated Substitute Teacher
positions.description:
·         On-call substitute teacher responsible for delivering lesson plans to students with typically only same-day or 1 day notice.
·         Ensures the classroom environment is conducive to learning by managing 30+ students through leadership and management skills.
·         Able to cover classes of all high school level subject matter, and assist students effectively by leveraging research and analytic skills.

positions.title: Computer Repair Technician
positions.description:
·         Deliver computer software and hardware support and troubleshooting services to a diverse group of residential and business customers.
·         Cut Windows 10 OS installation service timeframe from 2-3 days to same day service by introducing updated re-installation methodology.
·         Contributed in shaping best practices for various technical services for clients by leveraging existing computer knowledge and research skills.

positions.title: Instructional Student Assistant
positions.description:
·         Mentored computer science students in an intermittent university level Python programming course (CST 205). 
·         Provided creative recommendations to the instructor as to how to address unique student issues. Analyzed and edited weekly lesson plans that ensured a smooth learning process for the students, and that the computer science department was reflected in a positive light.
·         Assisted students with debugging their programs, grading their assignments and providing constructive feedback.

company.name: Computer Science Dept. - California State University, Monterey Bay

positions.title: Field Energy Consultant
positions.description:
·         Consulted with residential clients on the financial benefits of improving their home’s energy efficiency with solar photovoltaic systems.
·         Expressed complex concepts in easy to understand terms using self-developed products and oral skills.
·         Developed a large customer base by making myself highly available to clients and providing exceptional account management, which drove my referral based business portfolio.

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description:
·         Acquired and managed a diverse portfolio of business clients for RM Industries’ commercial cleaning services.
·         Developed a comprehensive client bidding software spreadsheet in Microsoft Excel for commercial cleaning services that expedited the business’ ability to produce high quality and detail oriented service offers for potential clients.
·         Responsible for website and search engine optimization for the business. Assisted with operations outside of the account executive role as needed by the business.

positions.title: Psychological Operations Specialist (E-4)
positions.description:
·         Coordinated and led efforts in Colombia and the Philippines for enhancing relations between the local government and the public.
·         These efforts involved partnering with Colombian and Filipino Army counterparts in providing free medical and dental services to impoverished children and their families, and conducting community outreach programs through local law enforcement to assess the needs of the community. This led to a better working relationship between the government and their people in these communities.
·         Received awards from the Philippine Army for the community outreach programs my team was responsible for launching, and U.S. Army South for my team’s efforts in Colombia.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteers as the toddler class lead during on 1-2 Sundays per month. Responsibilities include transitioning the class from one activity to the next, providing support to the teacher, and assisting students with activities.
